name: National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) - "Emergency Response Sanitation Unit (ERSU) Formation and Functionalisation"
benefit:
##### ***Institutional Setup Benefits***

- Establishment of Emergency Response Sanitation Unit in all Municipal Corporations, Water and Sewer Boards in capital cities, and district headquarters.
- Coverage area of 75 kilometers radius from each Emergency Response Sanitation Unit to serve smaller towns within the cluster.

##### ***Equipment and Safety Provisions***

- Provision of safety devices
_eligibility_text: ##### ***For Urban Local Bodies/Administrative Authorities*** - The applicant must be a Municipal Corporation seeking to establish Emergency Response Sanitation Unit. - The applicant must be a Water and Sewer Board located in capital cities of States or Union Territories. - The applicant must be district headquarters administration requiring emergency sanitation response capabilities. - The applicant must designate a Responsible Sanitation Authority as District Magistrate or Municipal Commissioner for their respective jurisdiction. - The applicant must establish and maintain functional helpline number 14420 for citizen emergency sanitation service requests. - The applicant must complete profiling of all Sewer and Septic Tank Workers within their jurisdiction through organised profiling camps. ##### ***Operational Requirements*** - The applicant should demonstrate capability to serve emergency cleaning operations within 75 kilometers radius including smaller clustered towns. - The applicant should ensure availability of trained manpower for Emergency Response Sanitation Unit operations. - The applicant should maintain requisite safety equipment and devices for confined space entry operations. ##### ***Training and Compliance Requirements*** - The applicant must ensure completion of occupational training of all identified Sewer and Septic Tank Workers before seeking reimbursement. - The applicant should designate and train Sewer Entry Professionals for emergency manual cleaning operations. - The applicant must comply with provisions of Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation Act, 2013 and Rules framed thereunder. ##### ***For Sanitation Workers*** - The beneficiary must be a Sewer and Septic Tank Worker engaged in cleaning and maintenance of sewers and septic tanks. - The beneficiary should be employed by Urban Local Bodies, parastatal agencies, or Private Sanitation Service Organisations. - The beneficiary must be above 18 years of age for availing training and safety equipment benefits. - The beneficiary should participate in profiling camps organised by Urban Local Bodies for database creation. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must maintain continuous operation of helpline number 14420 with adequate response mechanism. - The applicant must ensure only trained and certified Sewer Entry Professionals undertake manual cleaning in exceptional cases with proper authorization from Responsible Sanitation Authority. - The applicant must submit utilisation reports and maintain records of Emergency Response Sanitation Unit operations for monitoring purposes. - The applicant should provide institutional framework for Emergency Response Sanitation Unit with trained manpower availability. - The applicant must ensure compliance with Manual Scavenging Act 2013 provisions during all operations.
